name: zincsight-preview
description: Experimental zinc-binding-site predictions from protein structures, with coordinating residues, zinc coordinates and probability scores. Runs on demand with embedded PostgreSQL.

interface.shortDescription: Explore zinc-binding sites in protein structures
interface.longDescription: Run experimental ZincSight predictions from PDB IDs and assemblies, UniProt accessions, AlphaFold model IDs, MGYP IDs or PDB/mmCIF files. Inspect coordinating residues, zinc positions and model probability scores. Runs in a supported task environment with embedded PostgreSQL, without a separate database account or API key. This preview contains reproducibility fixes and can differ from historical ZincSight outputs; it is not the published scientific release.
defaultPrompt: Use ZincSight Preview on PDB 1KLS and report coordinating residues and zinc positions.
Use ZincSight Preview on UniProt P0A6G5 with histidine rotamer sampling.
Use ZincSight Preview to analyze my uploaded protein structure and save the full prediction JSON.
